summary: v52g+ — Fixed CSRF 403 on escrow profile change-request submit. Login paths now cache the server-issued CSRF token in sessionStorage (same pattern used by admin/vendor logins), so iframe/partitioned-cookie sessions still send a valid X-CSRF-Token header.

verification.sessionStorage_cache: After /escrow/login, sessionStorage['pmc.csrf'] contains the CSRF token.
verification.change_request_submit: POST /api/v1/escrow-accounts/me/change-requests returned 200; UI showed 'Change request submitted — awaiting PMC review' and the pending row (website -> https://demo-escrow.example.com).
verification.no_csrf_error: 'CSRF token missing or invalid' no longer appears in the page body.
